facts.fact: The BCT's circular no. 2026-10 of 25 September 2026 raised payment-account ceilings (level 1 from 500 to 1,500 dinars, level 2 to 5,000, level 3 to 20,000), allowed remote opening and created an uncapped merchant account, per African Manager.
African Manager says the BCT's report covers non-bank payment institutions authorised to open payment accounts, six authorised at end-2025 with 113,739 accounts.
